info.title: Celonis Machine Learning Workbench APIs
info.description: Documentation for the external Machine Learning APIs. These APIs allow you to trigger executions, manage resources, and more. To access the APIs, a Bearer API Key and a team-specific AppKey must be passed in the header.

tags.name: Notebook
tags.description: The Notebook API is used to create, read, update, and delete notebooks.

tags.name: Schedule
tags.description: The Schedule API is used to create, read, update, and delete schedules.

tags.name: Notebook Resources
tags.description: The Notebook Resources API configures notebook resource such as CPU, memory, storage, and gpu.

tags.name: Notebook Execution
tags.description: The Notebook Executions API is used to trigger, stop, and track notebook executions.

tags.name: Job Execution
tags.description: The Job Execution API is used to trigger, stop, and track job executions.

tags.name: Job Execution Group
tags.description: The Job Execution Group API retrieves job execution groups.
